query:
SELECT s.instance_id AS "instance_id: InstanceId", e.advertise_url
            FROM services s
            JOIN instance_endpoints e ON e.instance_id = s.instance_id
            JOIN instance_presence p ON p.instance_id = s.instance_id
            WHERE s.name = $1
              AND s.status = $2
              AND s.instance_id <> $3
              AND s.heartbeat_at
                  >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $4::double precision)
              AND e.heartbeat_at
                  >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $4::double precision)
              AND (
                  p.role <> $5
                  OR EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM instance_leases l
                      WHERE l.lease_key = s.module_name || ':' || s.name
                        AND l.owner_instance_id = s.instance_id
                        AND l.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                  )
              )
            ORDER BY s.heartbeat_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
